$comment: Affichez brand tokens, 2026. Extracted from affichez.ca on 2026-09-11. Machine-readable mirror of tokens.css — for design tools, native apps, email templates, or any pipeline that can't consume CSS. tokens.css is the source of truth; keep this in step with it.

retired.logo: uppercase AFFICHEZ with the brush swoosh (#F18C20)

primary.$comment: Action only — never severity. `press` is the AA-safe orange for small TEXT on white (5:1); `base` is 3.4:1 and is for fills, icons and large type. Type on an orange fill is white.

ink.$comment: `mute` clears AA on white and on sand.

band.$comment: Full-width section bands, as the site stacks them. Lime only ever sits on black. Black runs edge to edge, never as a half-screen.

status.$comment: Deliberately NOT brand colours. Always pair with a word — colour alone is not a status.

font.$comment: Headings are 600, never 700 — the site sets even its 55px titles at 600.

fontSize.$comment: rem against a 16px root. [size, lineHeight, letterSpacing]

radius.$comment: md (10px) is every button, input, toggle and tab — controls are rectangles, never pills. `signature` is the site's one sweeping corner, used on a band or photo.

shadow.$comment: Neutral, never tinted. The site is flat — colour bands, not cards.

logo.clearSpace: at least half the logo's height on every side

voice.positioning: Agence marketing 360 et numérique au Québec
